receipt.query: Persistent offline content similarity coherence index fingerprints candidate grouping rebuildable advisory learning versus immutable decoder dependencies compatibility migration

arguments: Persistent offline content similarity coherence index fingerprints candidate grouping rebuildable advisory learning versus immutable decoder dependencies compatibility migration

results.content:
Use paged namespace/content indexes and a persistent incremental scan cursor.
Discover candidates through bounded similarity-index queries rather than an
all-pairs search or a RAM-resident list of the whole filesystem. Track stable
file/content generations, invalidate changed candidates, checkpoint progress and
resume after restart. Fresh contention admission and prompt foreground yield
apply to every scan/grouping/encoding increment, including GPU work. Current
flat-store prototype limits need a scalable replacement, not larger constants.

CPU-only degraded operation may be slower; encoder, size and performance parity
are not requirements. Decode must be self-contained without GPU, its runtime,
a network service or a separately fetched model, with bounded resources and
forward progress.

Other cases cover limits, pressure before mutation, exhausted allowances,
competing/moved/poisoned owners, unsupported capability, foreign volume, invalid
counts/order/confidence/backend, nonzero padding, equal-sequence disagreement,
nonadjacent sequences, exact extent and failed reads. A separate transactional
user image remains independently readable when both advisory records are lost.

These are configured tests until the publishing-commit results are inspected.
They do not establish physical-media durability, hostile-provider isolation,
Windows helper integration, learning quality, background interference or GPU gain.

Apply crash-safe encoding, integrity, private candidate construction, complete
verification, durable publication and recovery-copy lifecycle to this area.
Interrupted training, short writes, cancellation, process death and power-loss
models must leave a coherent older or newly published state with explicit
acknowledgement semantics. Repair must preserve surviving verified information
and acknowledged file data; inconsistent/ambiguous state must never authorize
speculative mutation. Define actual backend flush/failure assumptions and test
each claimed failure domain.

A dictionary or model needed to decode existing extents is data-critical.
Retain its verified immutable version, references, recovery copies and CPU reader
until every referencing extent/snapshot has safely retired. Rebuilding optional
learning summaries cannot replace a lost decoding dependency or justify
re-encoding/deleting sole surviving source bytes.

Then compare protected base/delta and shared-dictionary candidates with compact
integer-predictor candidates on held-out file families. Fit selection to complete
stored bytes, including dependencies, redundancy and restart indexes. Retain
larger learned models as candidates when their measured total-size gain pays for
their footprint and access cost. No candidate is selected from a paper's headline
ratio, and the final GPU-supported collective codec remains unimplemented.

- Shared trained dictionaries with explicit identity, lifecycle and recovery.
- Exact duplicate blocks, content-defined chunks and zero/sparse extents, with
  collision-safe verification, bounded indexing and crash-safe references.
- Reversible transforms for structured numeric and tabular data, executable
  code and repeated byte planes. Always retain a generic arbitrary-byte route.
- Bounded AMD HIP batching for stages that actually benefit from parallelism,
  accounting for upload, dispatch, download, GPU contention and CPU fallback.
- Background recompression only after transactional publication, resource
  admission, cancellation and independent recovery are implemented and tested.
